failure_reasons: semantic/inline-comment-quality: The comments are brief and generally useful: they explain retaining the least-loaded technician, treating absent map entries as zero open tickets, and preserving the first technician on a tie. However, the requested non-obvious initial sentinel step is not explicitly explained: the initialization of fewest to Integer.MAX_VALUE has no comment stating why that sentinel allows the first technician/load to be selected. This is a minor completeness deduction, and the comments otherwise use appropriate WHAT/WHY-oriented explanations rather than line-by-line restatement.
